gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-psalter-p: Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi reads friendly and unfussy, its e wide-mouthed and its capitals barely taller than the lowercase. Dogica stamps out heavy, wide-spaced headings, and the body just talks plainly beneath.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-sinhala: Dark, dense and unmistakable, Noto Sans Sinhala lays a thick stripe of lowercase through every line. Dogica heads it in heavy, wide-set letters, but curve endings in the body never crowd, so text keeps moving.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC opens its curves outward instead of curling in, leaving generous counters in the tall lowercase. And Dogica, heavy and widely tracked, handles the shouting while the body font stays approachable.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-noto-sans-thai: Puffy as inflated glass beads, Noto Sans Thai leaves its rounded letters open, softening the heavy, wide-tracked weight of Dogica. Heavy against soft is the whole appeal, and it lands immediately.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-orienta: Orienta reads modern and open, its counters breathing freely with little height difference between cases. Dogica hits hard in the heading, but Orienta keeps long text moving easily.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-puritan: Puritan reads friendly, with rounded forms that stay open to the side. Beneath the heavy, wide-set Dogica headings, its oversized a and e counters let text flow along comfortably line after line.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-questrial: Dogica leads with a heavy, wide, commanding presence. It does loud, chunky headings best, while Questrial, flat and single-weight with open shapes, handles the quieter work underneath.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-radio-canada: Radio Canada draws one steady line, with no pressure variation at all. That blueprint-lettering constancy set against the heavy, wide-tracked Dogica gives the headings real authority over the text below.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-sarpanch: Heavy, wide and blunt, Dogica shouts the heading in no uncertain terms. Sarpanch does the friendlier work beneath, its open-mouthed e and compact lowercase height keeping lines tidy and approachable.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-sen: Tall and constant-weight, Sen traces each letter in one unbroken line. Its curves end before turning inward and match the stems, a quiet counterweight to the heavy, wide-tracked Dogica headings.
